turns.user_utterance: What's going on with the top-up? All it says is pending, pending, pending! I use your service several times a week and have never had a problem before! What's going on here?
turns.assistant_response: Sorry about that—if your top-ups are showing “pending” repeatedly, it usually means the card/payment network hasn’t completed processing yet. Can you tell me: (1) the last 4 digits of the card you used for the top-up, (2) the amount and currency, and (3) the date/time of the top-up? Then I can help check whether it’s still processing or if it will revert.
